publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
title_or_table: Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 9, Summary of Receipts by Source, and Outlays by Function of the U.S. Government (September issues, fiscal year to date)
universe_or_base: Net federal outlays by budget function, as Treasury reports them
unit: dollars, nominal, exactly as published (to the cent); a chart rounds once, at print
vintage: September Monthly Treasury Statements as served on November 11, 2026
qualification: Net outlays: two lines can be negative (Commerce and Housing Credit in some years, and Undistributed Offsetting Receipts every year), so a treemap draws only the positive functions and states what it leaves out; functions group spending by purpose, not by agency

function.description: budget function as Treasury names it; Total is all net outlays

outlays_dollars.description: net outlays in the fiscal year, as published

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 9, outlays by function, fiscal 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Net outlays in nominal dollars; offsetting receipts are shown as negative.

source_line_variants.all_years: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 9, outlays by function, fiscal 2015 to 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Net outlays in nominal dollars; offsetting receipts are shown as negative.
source_line_variants.treemap_fy2026: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 9, outlays by function, fiscal 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Tiles show the functions with positive net outlays, $7,566.3 billion against total net outlays of $7,395.8 billion; offsetting receipts and Commerce and Housing Credit, both negative, are left out.
source_line_variants.treemap_fy2026_september_statement: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Monthly Treasury Statement, September 2026, Table 9, outlays by function, fiscal 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Tiles show the functions with positive net outlays, $7,566.3 billion against total net outlays of $7,395.8 billion; offsetting receipts and Commerce and Housing Credit, both negative, are left out.

notes: A treemap can draw only positive functions: in fiscal 2026 they sum to $7,566.3 billion, against net outlays of $7,395.8 billion, so each tile's share is a share of the positive functions and the chart says so (fix pass, statistics S15)

Fiscal 2026 rows come from the Monthly Treasury Statement for September 2026 (record date September 30, 2026). Read again November 12, 2026 from the same API: all 20 fiscal 2026 lines equal the frozen rows. Fiscal 2026 figures may change in the Treasury’s year-end report; variant treemap_fy2026_september_statement names the statement (statistics review S6)
